init.title: Urgency thresholds
init.description: Tune when Car Parker considers a sweep 'urgent' or 'soon'. These drive sensor.car_parker_urgency, binary_sensor.move_car_now, and the dashboard colors.

data_description.urgent_hours: A sweep this many hours away (or less) is flagged 'urgent' and turns on move_car_now. Default: 2.
data_description.soon_days: A sweep this many days away (or less), but not yet urgent, is flagged 'soon'. 0 = only today counts as soon. Default: 1 (today and tomorrow).
data_description.car_tracker: If your car reports its location to HA (e.g. Subaru Starlink), pick its device_tracker here. It powers the 'Park at car' button, the ignition-off auto-park, and shows the car's live location on the dashboard. Leave empty if you don't have one.
